responsibility: Builds pseudo live ranges and related liveness metadata for LRA. It scans RTL to create per-pseudo live-range lists over LRA program points, conflict and preference information, hard-register usage counts, call/setjmp liveness, copy data, and updated REG_DEAD/REG_UNUSED notes, and it can recalculate global BB live-in/live-out bitmaps when local transformations change border liveness. The resulting structures are consumed by assignment, coalescing, rematerialization, and spill-slot allocation.
